name: wheres-walter
description: Where's Walter? — a procedurally generated hidden-object game (solo, challenge & real-time multiplayer).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
